name: Tailoring (any clothes)
lead: Tailoring is the alteration of ready-made clothes to the wearer's measurements, such as hemming trousers, taking in shirts or adjusting sleeves. Bespoke or made-to-measure goes further and builds a garment from scratch.

In style advice, fit is routinely ranked above brand as a factor in appearance. No specific clinical literature was found, and the claim rests on fashion practice and general research on clothing and impression formation.

paras: Alteration removes excess fabric and aligns seams with shoulders, waist and length, so the garment follows body lines instead of hanging or pulling.
Costs are modest relative to results, but alterations are limited by seam allowance and cannot fix every garment. Poor tailoring can ruin a piece. It is a temporary effect tied to the garments.
